dedupe_keys.name: statistics greenland statbank pxweb api tables on electricity electric heating district heating and water sold by the utility nukissiorfiit by town and settlement group since 2004 with register based dwelling stock by district type and floor area archived 1996 to 2010

description: Statistics Greenland runs a PxWeb statbank with an open JSON API. Its subject tree has no census folder, and housing and infrastructure figures come from registers and utility records. The energy folder has a table of electricity, electric heating, district heating and water sold by Nukissiorfiit, the national utility, by product for each town, for the settlements of each municipality and in total, every year from 2004 to 2024. In 2024 it sold 228.95 million kWh of electricity at normal rates, 27.85 million of it in settlements, and 239.66 million kWh of district heating. A second table gives water consumption by user group. Archived housing tables count dwellings by district, town or village and building type from 1996 to 2010, and by floor area. Coverage is national. Format and access: open PxWeb API with CSV, JSON and PX output, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: dwelling tables stop in 2010; utility sales cover only Nukissiorfiit supply areas; location codes mix towns and settlement groups. Simulation uses: demand baselines for isolated Arctic grids and district heating systems. Related records: none for Greenland statistics in the catalogue.

schema_summary: ENE4NUK: product (electricity at normal and fishing industry rates in kWh, electric heating kWh, district heating kWh, water at normal and fishing industry rates in m3) by location (total, towns, settlements, each municipality, named towns and the settlements of each municipality; 30 codes) and year. ENE3VND: water consumption by use (industries, services, households). BOEBE2: dwellings by district (20 codes), place (town or village) and type (one-family, terrace, storey dwelling). BOEBEST2: dwellings by floor area band.
